'''Aura''' ({{G|Aura}}) is the [[intrinsic]] of [[Glow Berries|glow berries]]. Shortly after a glow berry dish is eaten, a bell rings and every creature within 50 blocks receives the {{MCW|Glowing}} effect, which outlines it through walls. It is meant for caving: the developer suggests bringing glow berries along when exploring caves.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If they're caving, they should probably grab some glow berries or carrots.}}</ref>

Each food also heals the player; see its page.

== Mechanics ==
Aura is not a status effect on the player. Each aura food is marked with custom data, and eating one triggers a hidden advancement that runs the aura function for its duration (3, 30 or 60 seconds):<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/30s.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/30s.mcfunction}}</ref>
# A bell resonating sound plays at the player.
# After 48 ticks (2.4 seconds), every entity within 50 blocks of the player, except the player, receives {{MCW|Glowing}} for the food's duration, with no particles.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/apply_glow.macro.mcfunction}}</ref>
# The advancement is revoked, so it can trigger again.

The glow is applied to every living entity in range: hostile and passive mobs, villagers and other players. Non-living entities (armor stands, boats, minecarts, paintings and item frames) are skipped, and other non-living entities such as items and arrows can't be given effects at all, so they don't glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/entity_type/aura_immune.json}}</ref> Entities that move into range after the pulse do not start glowing, and glowing entities keep their outline even if they move away.

=== Behavior in multiplayer ===
Each player has their own scoreboard timer, so the pulse is centred on the player who ate the food, not on the player nearest the world spawn. Eating another aura food while a pulse is still charging (within 2.4 seconds) does not start a second pulse; the pending pulse uses the duration of the food eaten last.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/effect.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/locate_players.mcfunction}}</ref>
